about: bank 0 $61B6-$67FF: the main loop, the phase dispatcher with its 77-entry phase table, and the reset, attract mode and game start phase routines

B0:61B6.name: WAITFRAME
B0:61B6.desc: the main loop, Star Wars's WAITFRAME and MAIN which the matcher missed. waits for the IRQ to set GMSYNC, once per game frame. if the stack is not at its top a phase routine has called this loop to wait a frame and it returns into that routine. otherwise it reads the gun switches and their edges (this part was in IFRAME in Star Wars), handles the freeze option, where holding left fire steps frames at a growing rate, calls IFRAME and then the routine of the current phase through TPHASE

B0:62D3.name: IFRAME
B0:62D3.desc: Star Wars's IFRAME, init game frame, without the switch reading that moved into the main loop: steps the 16-bit frame counter, sends the coin sound command once when the first credit appears, has bank 1 move the player's place in the high score table (KE209) and pulls the cursor position from the IRQ's pot values

B0:630A.name: init_parms
B0:630A.desc: Star Wars's IPARM, whose name the listing has given to another routine: init the general parameters (init_general) and the player's ship (NW1SHP)

B0:6311.name: init_general
B0:6311.desc: the three parts of Star Wars's IPGEN, now in three places: random generator check and math box constants (IPGEN), bank 1's clear of the object list (JINOBJ) and page 1's init of the gun shot blocks (P1_8EFC)

B0:63D6.desc: adjust one saved pot limit for PHERES: X points at the saved byte, A returns the value to use. a saved value of $40 or more gives $40, a lower one is moved up by an eighth of its distance to $40 plus 1

B0:63E5.name: PHIBNR
B0:63E5.desc: phase $01, Star Wars's PHIBNR which the matcher missed: init of the banner (title) phase. loads display list set 0, turns the messages off, starts the banner, restores the math box and the ship, and about every 6.7 minutes, if the attract music option is on, starts one of the five tunes of TMUSIC at random

B0:6445.name: PHEBNR
B0:6445.desc: phase $02, Star Wars's PHEBNR which the matcher missed: one frame of the banner phase. draws the stars, the banner (bank 1 K66D0), the special messages, the coin lines, the score line and the Jedi letters, moves the stars, flashes the Jedi letters and checks the start and test switches. new in this game: when the banner counter reaches $200 it goes on to the scoring page

B0:64DC.name: view_ins_page
B0:64DC.desc: view the flight instructions page for PHEINS, a copy of VWPAGE without the scroll: counts the phase timer up, turns on the next line every 8 frames, puts the shield count digit of the option switches into the line that names it, fades the messages out from frame $140 and sets the timer to $200 when they are dark, which ends the phase

B0:6538.name: PHISCR
B0:6538.desc: phase $03, Star Wars's PHISCR which the matcher missed: init of the scoring page. the page starts $3C0 down and scrolls up, lines are messages $24 to $2A

B0:6592.name: VWPAGE
B0:6592.desc: Star Wars's VWPAGE which the matcher missed, here used by the scoring page only: counts the phase timer up (it counted down in Star Wars), turns on the next line every 8 frames, scrolls the page up 8 units a frame until its offset is 0, fades the messages out from frame $140 and sets the timer to $200 when they are dark, which ends the phase

B0:65EB.name: VWCOIN
B0:65EB.desc: Star Wars's VWCOIN which the matcher missed: the two coin lines of the attract screens. first line: with no credit "game over" and "insert coins" alternate, with credit "pull trigger to start". second line: "free play" in free play mode (new in this game), else the cost of a game or the number of credits with a half sign for a partial credit. Y = display list pointer

B0:66E9.name: hiscore_init
B0:66E9.desc: phase $09 (PHS_HIS): init of the high score table display. this is Star Wars's PHIHIS, whose name the listing has given to the design team page at L6671. blue for the table, messages off, math box and ship restored, high scores checked for reasonableness by bank 1

B0:6713.name: hiscore_exec
B0:6713.desc: phase $0A: one frame of the high score table display, Star Wars's PHEHIS with the timer counting up. draws the copyright message, stars, score line, coin lines, the table in the phase colour (faded from frame $B0) and the Jedi letters, moves the stars forward, and after $100 frames goes back to the banner. checks the start and test switches

B0:6776.name: CPYRGHT
B0:6776.desc: Star Wars's CPYRGHT cut down to one message: draws message $00, the title and the three copyright lines. Y = display list pointer

B0:677B.name: PHISG1
B0:677B.desc: phase $0B, Star Wars's PHISG1 cut down: entered when the start switch is accepted. loads display list set 0 and sends a sound command, then goes on to PHESG1

B0:678F.name: game_vars_init
B0:678F.desc: reset the per-game variables, the second half of Star Wars's PHESG1: no attract music after the game, messages off, Jedi letters cleared, frame counter 0, shields from the option switches (2 to 5), Jedi time, difficulty adder and gas gauge flags cleared, cursor centred and the pot limits perturbed. PHESG1 falls into it and the continue offer (L69B0) calls it

4C47.name: step_delay
4C47.desc: freeze option: frame times left until the next single step. held at 2 while left fire is up, counted down in the main loop while it is held, reloaded from step_rate at each step

4C48.name: step_rate
4C48.desc: freeze option: the delay to load after the next single step. 10 when left fire goes down, then 2 less at each step down to 2, so a held fire switch steps faster and faster

4C4A.name: wave_bcd
4C4A.desc: wave number in BCD as the score line shows it: 1 after reset, GM_DIF + 1 (at most 99) when a wave begins. bank 1's bookkeeping keeps the highest value

4C50.name: jedi_time
4C50.desc: 3 bytes, the last a fraction: time left of the state that follows the completion of the four Jedi letters. page 1 sets the top word to $01C0 when the fourth letter is earned and counts it down every frame (P1_95F1) at a rate picked by jedi_count. the game start clears the top word

4C59.name: diff_step
4C59.desc: amount by which diff_adder grows after a wave: 0 at game start, one more after each of the first three waves

4C5A.name: diff_adder
4C5A.desc: difficulty adder: added to twice a part's wave level to give the enemy skill level $4C5B. set to the difficulty option (OPTS1 bits 3-2) when a game starts and raised by diff_step after each of the first three waves

4C72.name: rank_index
4C72.desc: index of the high score table entry the player's score has to reach next: $18, the last of the 25, at reset and at game start, stepped down by bank 1 KE209 each frame the score has reached that entry, minus when the score is the best. the score line shows that entry and the place

4C7D.name: jedi_count
4C7D.desc: how many times the four Jedi letters have been completed in this game, held at 3. index of the rate at which jedi_time runs down. cleared at game start

4C82.name: jedi_show
4C82.desc: state of the Jedi letters display that page 1 P1_9663 draws: 0 off, 1 a letter just earned is growing into place, 2 letters shown. the attract phases switch it between 0 and 2 every 32 frames to flash the letters of the last game

4C83.name: jedi_blink
4C83.desc: frame counter stepped by page 1 P1_9645 on every frame a phase calls it. the attract phases flash the Jedi letters when its low 5 bits are 0. cleared at the end of a game

4C84.name: jedi_on
4C84.desc: set again every frame by page 1 P1_9645: 1 while jedi_time is running or a letter is growing into place (jedi_show 1), else 0. the star and laser drawing take another colour while it is set. cleared at game start

4C85.name: jedi_done
4C85.desc: 1 once the four Jedi letters have been completed in this game, cleared at game start. the end of game and the initials phase then save the wave and score reached for the continue offer

4BF8.name: cont_used
4BF8.desc: set when a game is started from the continue offer (phase $12), cleared at a normal game start. bank 1's bookkeeping counts such a game and clears it

4CCB.name: kill_count
4CCB.desc: counted up, to 50 at most, by the page 1 kill routine P1_8E33 of the walker part. the next walker part setup (page 0 P0_9561) takes 4 + count/5, at most 9, from it into $4BFE and clears it. cleared at game start

4CD0.name: coin_spoken
4CD0.desc: Star Wars's COINSP: the credit count for which the coin sound was made. 0 with no credits, so the first credit sounds, then $FF once more credits have come in

4CDE.name: foa_said
4CDE.desc: set by page 2 P2_92EE once it has sent the sound command of SPKFOA, so that it is sent once in a game. cleared at game start

4CAE.name: ph_col_brt
4CAE.desc: PH_COL+1, the brightness byte of the phase colour, where the listing shows it as a bare address: the attract pages step it down to fade their messages and the message drawing (B0:E782) reads it

questions: B0:6671 PHIHIS and B0:668D PHEHIS carry the Star Wars high score names and descriptions, but here they are phases $07/$08, a page that shows message $01 (Atari's game design team) and fades it. the high score table phases, with Star Wars's PHIHIS/PHEHIS code, are B0:66E9/B0:6713 (phases $09/$0A, PHS_HIS = $09). i named those hiscore_init/hiscore_exec because the Atari names are taken - the carried names at 6671/668D should be dropped or moved

other carried names on phase table routines outside my range that do not fit what the routine is here: PHESP1/PHESP2 (probot part), PHISP2 at B0:6EBE (walker part), PHES0G at B0:70E3 (asteroid part setup, phase $48), PHES0D at B0:736C (death in the TIE fighter part, execute), PHINXT at B0:751F (training manual init, phase $43), IPARM at B0:A39D (a view routine - Star Wars's IPARM is B0:630A, named init_parms here)
B0:6623: the two bytes $20 $0A are code, an unreachable BRA L662F after the BRA at L6621 (Star Wars has the same dead BRA at its L6402)

$4813: cleared once in PHISG2 next to S_BCCNT (B0:67F1) and not seen as a bare operand anywhere else. it lies between S_CNCT ($4812) and S_BCCNT ($4814), where this game has one byte more than Star Wars, so it is probably coin routine state reached by indexing. not named
phases $3D/$3E (B0:73FC/B0:740E) and phase $30 (second table entry of B0:7229): no code found that sets PHASE to them - dead as far as i can tell
STRTCK: the carried comments say extreme left goes to the instruction phase, but the phase it sets here ($03) is the scoring page. free play here gives 2 credits (B0:6340)

the sound routine names SPKI (first coin, B0:62ED) and SPKLOS (start of game, B0:6780) are carried from Star Wars by command number - what they sound like in this game is for the sound annotation to say
kill_count ($4CCB): i take P1_8E33 to be the walker kill routine because it bumps $4C56, the walker part's bonus count - not checked further
jedi_time ($4C50): what the state after completing the letters gives the player (the scoring page says 10 x scoring after earning Jedi letter) i did not verify

several carried comments in PHERES, PHEBNR and PHISG2 sit one line off because of inserted instructions (for example NO HIGH SCORES YET on STA $4C4A at B0:63C1, ALLOW COIN ROUTINE TO INIT ITSELF on STA $4C72 at B0:63D2, SETUP VG PSUEDO-ROM on the banner view at B0:644B)

names taken from the other notes files where they had already named an address: cont_used, wave_bcd, jedi_time, diff_step, diff_adder, rank_index, jedi_show, jedi_blink, jedi_on, jedi_done. those files disagree with each other on $4C5A (diff_add in b0_6800, diff_adder in b0_7000), $4C72 (rank_index in b0_6800, hs_next in b0_a800), $4C85 (jedi_done in b0_6800, jedi_earned in b0_7000) and $4C50 (jedi_tim in b0_a800) - one name each has to be picked
$4CAE is PH_COL+1 - named ph_col_brt here only because the listing shows it bare, the generator may prefer to print PH_COL+1
